summary: CKGSB's marketing team is juggling a live knowledge website redesign, a strategic pivot to prioritize Asia Star and Intelligent China for global SEO, and a backlog of review tasks, while firefighting an Outlook account lockout.
summaryDetail: The most immediate issue is an Outlook account lockout affecting multiple devices, which the team is resolving by resetting passwords and re-logging in; they also need to contact JSB to confirm the backend lock is cleared. In parallel, the knowledge website redesign is in full swing: Joseph must share the HTML design file and the team needs to meet to finalize feedback on menu categorization, article pages, and indices before Joker implements changes. Strategically, the team is doubling down on China-based programs—Asia Star and Intelligent China—for SEO and marketing, with Joseph drafting a plan, the team analyzing participant profiles, and auditing conversion tracking. Looking ahead, a cluster of reviews are due mid-September, including the WIL Forum agenda, Investor Sentiment Survey translation, Custom Program page rewrite, September newsletter, and Li Wei's article translation, plus coordination for licensing recorded courses with Unico Skill. The internal linking system is now live with 1,444 of 1,669 articles linked, marking a significant milestone for the knowledge site.

meetings.summary: The team discussed prioritizing China-based programs (Asia Star and Intelligent China) for SEO and marketing, with a focus on understanding target audience and conversion tracking. They agreed to draft a plan and audit existing tracking setups.

decisions.text: Remove the videos panel and integrate videos into topics instead of having a separate category.
Keep the two-menu structure with 'Knowledge' and 'School' menus.
Adopt the article page design with prominent authors, audio, pullout quotes, and varied title font sizes.
Include indices (BCI, BSI, CKGSB) on the knowledge homepage, similar to the school homepage.
Display more articles on the homepage, including a pinned article and a section for latest articles.
Prioritize Asia Star and Intelligent China programs for marketing efforts.
Put US partnership programs on hold initially, but consider Berkeley as a third priority.
Focus on China-based programs due to higher demand from overseas executives.
The internal linking system is now live on the CKGSB Knowledge website, with 1,444 of 1,669 articles linked.
